pages.text: At Tier 4, leftover $(bold)progression tokens$() convert straight into $(bold)vanilla experience$(), since the top of the ladder has no threshold left to spend them on.$(br2)Every banked token becomes XP for Aptitudes, the enchanting table or anvil repairs, from the overshoot you never spent advancing to everything Tier 4 content keeps minting.

pages.title: How to Exchange
pages.text: Run $(bold)/icraft codex exchange <tier> <amount>$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)tier$(): $(bold)1$(), $(bold)2$() or $(bold)3$(), the token to spend.$(li)$(bold)amount$(): a number, or $(bold)all$() for every token of that tier.$(br2)Example: $(bold)/icraft codex exchange 3 all$() cashes in all your Codex Token III at once, and the XP lands on your bar immediately.$(br2)$(note)Before Tier 4, the command just tells you it is locked.$()

pages.title: The Rate
pages.text: Higher-tier tokens come from harder content, so they are worth more XP:$(br)$(li)$(t1)Codex Token I$(): $(bold)2 XP$() each.$(li)$(t2)Codex Token II$(): $(bold)4 XP$() each.$(li)$(t3)Codex Token III$(): $(bold)8 XP$() each.$(br2)Tokens are a bonus on top of the XP you already earn, and $(bold)Intelligence$()'s XP-gain skills make every exchange go further.

pages.title: What the XP Buys
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Aptitudes$(): every level-up costs vanilla XP, and the exchange funds your last ones.$(li)$(bold)Enchanting$(): fuel for the enchanting table.$(li)$(bold)Repairs$(): combining and mending gear on the anvil.$(br2)Where tokens come from: $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Next: at Tier 4, run /icraft codex exchange 3 all.$()
